reviewPurpose: Semantically verify that every field of the canonical OVERVIEW row for TM106 is covered by dft-meta.json and dft-conditions.yaml, and that each derived testCondition field is explained by a source locator.
rule: Read the single OVERVIEW row of Dali_testmode.xlsx (plaintext sha256 896770d29f8ae58852e1031c1e6210c5435e52df38e0f6a0fb8fc1836622c04b) and compare rawIntent with testCondition field by field. A source contradiction is preserved as an open item and reported, never resolved. No value may be inferred, no source substituted, no hash re-bound.

fieldChecks.evidence: testCondition.identity copies OVERVIEW columns Item, Level, Name, Description, Purpose and Unit verbatim for the single row whose Item is TM106.
OVERVIEW column Trim is empty for TM106, so the item is not a trim test.
OVERVIEW column Code1 declares vset[vbat,3,100e-6,0] as the static rail and the Power column names VBAT; the 100e-6 ramp slot makes it a direct power-on.

rawIntent.Notes:
ramp up/down vbus from 3~5V,
mux A2D_VBUS_PRST to dtest0
check int pin toggle

fieldChecks.evidence: OVERVIEW column Code2 contains vset[vbus,5,1e-3,0] and vset[vbus,3,1e-3,0] (non-100e-6 ramp slot) and the Notes column states ramp up/down vbus from 3~5V, so hasRamp is true.

testCondition.ramps carries one ordered vbus sweep copied from OVERVIEW column Code2 in source order: vset[vbus,3,100e-6,1] then vset[vbus,5,1e-3,0] then vset[vbus,3,1e-3,0]; no value is added or inferred.
OVERVIEW column Dynamic reads VBUS for TM106, so testCondition.dynamicPins contains exactly VBUS.

fieldChecks.evidence: No OVERVIEW column Name, Description, Notes or Special declares a high-current mode, so state is NOT_DECLARED.
OVERVIEW columns Code1 and Code2 supply the vset pin names vbat and vbus; the Check column supplies the logical monitor label V(DTEST0), kept as a label and not converted into a physical DUT pin.
OVERVIEW column Check is V(DTEST0) with the Unit column V, so quantity is VOLTAGE.

The OVERVIEW Notes column says check int pin toggle and the HELPER column says ramp VBUS, INT toggle, so isToggle is true and resultTypes are Rise and Fall (Hys is marked DERIVED, not source-declared).
OVERVIEW column Code2 contains field[(DMUX_EN,1),(DMUX_SEL,19)], preserved as register-field intent in source order.
testCondition.referenceValue is the OVERVIEW ExpectValue text rising vth 3.9V, hys 0.2V verbatim in Unit V.

testCondition.expectedValue is the OVERVIEW ExpectValue text verbatim; the de test column r 3.798 / f 3.613 is preserved as reference evidence and, per the approved TM106 adjudication, the ExpectValue text is the acceptance limit.
